pages.title: Pavane (Fauré)
pages.extract: The Pavane in F♯ minor, Op. 50, is a short work by the French composer Gabriel Fauré written in 1887.  It was originally a piano piece, but is better known in Fauré's version for orchestra and optional chorus. It was first performed in Paris in 1888, becoming one of the composer's most popular works.
